entries.en: If we could take the fight to these geth, we would. But we're not soldiers.
At least the geth can't regroup at the command post any more.
No one understands what we are trying to build here.
This colony will outlast any threat thrown at it.
This planet's not so bad when it isn't under the grip of some hidden threat.
It feels so good to be free again. We have another chance at making a home here.
We'll try our best to make this colony work. I know we can do it.
I guess Feros was bound to fail. Too many factors against us.
I look forward to getting back to Earth. This place was never home.
I want a home that isn't getting tossed around on the frontline of a war.
They tell me you survived Akuze. Glad you're on our side.
You were at the Skyllian Blitz, right? Never thought someone like you would help us.
You were at Torfan, right? Glad you're on our side.
You helped some of us survive. Guess that's better than nothing.
What's it say about Feros when a hero like you can't even save it?
I guess we're lucky anyone survived. No offense, but I don't want Feros remembered like Torfan.
Get ready.
How do you fight an army of synthetics? Are they even alive?
This is it. The last stand.
Stop the intruders at all costs.
They'll try to rebuild the command post soon enough.
At least we've got a chance to regroup.
I don't think I've slept since they began their attack.
They're still out there. I hate those geth.
I have my own thoughts again. Thank you, Commander.
Now that the alien influence is purged, we can get back to building a profitable colony.
We will build up our defenses and make sure Feros stays in human hands.
Feros will survive. Thanks to you.
It will take some effort to pull up stakes, but I'll be glad to be out of this hole.
I'm sorry I ever signed on to colonize this forsaken planet.
Living on the frontier was supposed to be exciting. Losing my mind to a plant was not part of the deal.
I'm sick of being a pawn. Colonial Affairs can shove this posting.
Stop the geth!
They'll be here any minute!
The geth fight like fanatics. That can't just be programming, can it?
We won't fall to to the geth without a fight.
Thanks for your help. At least we have time to regroup.
They're still out there. But at least they've been slowed.
We won't be safe until every last geth is destroyed.
The geth have destroyed our home. It'll take years to rebuild.
I am free... Thank you. I am so glad to get that plant out of my head.
I think I'll stay. Help reclaim the colony. It's a chance for a new beginning.
I want to try to make this colony work. I hope we'll have the chance now.
Feros will be back in shape in no time, Commander. We'll make sure of it.
I can't wait to get out of here, Shepard. This place may as well be cursed.
Nothing here is worth the pain I've been through.
I am so tired of being a pawn. I'm getting out while I can.
This is it for me. I'm going back to Earth on the next ship.
Glad to see some soldiers. Our numbers are getting thin.
We get weaker with every attack.
The geth just keep coming.
I've lost more friends in this battle than I can count.
They're coming. They just keep on coming.
The geth never get hungry. They never tire.
I hope Fai Dan can do something to stop the geth.
I can't go on much longer.
We couldn't bring much in the way of supplies with us. We need sustainable food.
What good is surviving the attacks if we starve?
Davin does what he can, but our food will run out sooner or later.
Hunger will weaken us in the long run.
We have enough food for everyone to operate at their optimum.
Now we must put our efforts towards stopping the geth.
At least we won't starve before the geth wipe us out.
This colony will survive. We will soon have all that we need.
The only thing I can say for that plant is it made me forget how hungry I am.
I prefer hunger to slavery, thank you very much.
You've done so much, Shepard. Thank you.
Nothing will stop us now. We'll tame this world.
They said we'd never last on Feros. We'll prove them wrong.
I didn't think we would get through this, but there's good times ahead.
We've lost it all, and we didn't have much to begin with.
No point in staying now. This place just isn't viable.
Another failed colony.... This won't play well at home.
Survival is something. You know about that, don't you, Shepard.
Feros is done. Even you war heroes know you can't win all the time.
I suppose we should be thankful for surviving. You've done clean-sweeps before, haven't you?
There, there, dear, you'll get through this. Just relax.
I'll be glad when I'm out of this place. I hate what happened here.
Nothing we did here was for us. We lived a lie even before the Thorian took us.
My headaches... are getting better. I just have to... stop thinking about the past.
Hello, offworlder. I'm glad that we aren't totally forgotten by the rest of the galaxy.
Dear, please try to rest. You're not ready to speak.
But they should know... unh.... I mean, they are very important.
Yes, that's better.
I am... fine. I just need to try to think clearly. It's just a lingering pain from... from the last attack. I'll be fine.
I can't see any significant damage, but something is clearly causing her pain.
Please, just let her rest. She just needs... rest.
I see no major injury, but something must be causing her pain.
I can't see anything significant, but something is clearly causing her pain.
She looks whole, but something's clearly causing her pain.
She is not visibly injured, but clearly, something is causing her pain.
It hurts so much when I think about what we've lost.
So many have died.... We should.... Unh.
We should flee.... No. We can't do that.
I can't think of a reason to leave. I can't think....
Thank you for everything you tried to do here.
Finally. We have hope again.
It was in my head. Like getting slapped every time your eyes left the ground.
I don't know if I want to stay, but I'm glad we have the choice.
Is there anything I can do for you?
I'm not going to catch anything from you, am I?
What's wrong?
I hope you're not contagious.
Yes... goodbye.
Goodbye.
I should go.
I need... rest.
Your help is appreciated, but we're not out of the woods yet.
We can take care of feeding ourselves now, but the geth are still a problem.
The geth are still our greatest concern.
You're the one who repelled that last wave.
They'll be back. And if the geth don't kill us, we'll die of hunger soon enough.
I need to boost rations with varren meat, but it's too dangerous.
I can't do anything until he's dead.
Hello again, Commander.
Excellent. I'll organize a hunt when the immediate threat of the geth is gone.
Of course. I don't want to delay you any more than I already have.
On the positive side, they'll attack anything. Even those damn synthetics.
The big alpha varren is the real problem. He's mad, erratic, completely unpredictable.
The colony is growing, or it was.... But you should speak with Fai Dan. He is our leader.
Hunting them is impossible while fending off the geth.
I'd rather you concentrated on the geth. Food won't help us if they breach our defenses.
So long, Commander.
It-- It doesn't hurt any more! I can think my own thoughts again.
We have a chance to start over, thanks to you.
That's great! I mean, varren tastes horrible, but with the geth gone, I can organize a hunt.
Thank you for not abandoning us like everyone else.
And with company money coming in, there's no need to choke down varren meat.
Thanks for everything. We owe you our lives.
Have you given any thought to helping us with our food shortage?
Thank you for your help. You've already done so much.
That would only help us in the short-term, unless you plan to make a trip every few days. We need to be self-sufficient.
Thank you for everything you did.
Thanks to you, Greta and I can start over.
The Thorian controlled us with pain.
I never expected this much trouble. I guess that's what makes it a frontier world.
I suppose you tried. Too bad it wasn't enough to save the colony.
It is a shame all our efforts were for nothing.
Why was everything stacked against us? We had so much hope for this colony.
We don't need to worry about food. We're all leaving soon enough.
Are you doing anything to remedy the situation?
I killed the big varren. The rest are yours.
Fork over the reward so I can get back to more important things.
Tell me about Zhu's Hope.
Why should I speak with Fai Dan? Why can't you tell me?
Tell me about hunting varren.
I have a ship. I could bring in supplies from offworld.
I have to go.
I took out what looked like the oldest of the varren. The rest are yours.
Can't you and the others hunt on your own now that the geth have been removed?
I'll look into it when I get a chance.
I could ferry in more than enough food to cover your immediate needs.
Just pay up.
Colony
Hunting varren
You tell me.
I killed a varren alpha male.
Why not do it yourself?
I'll help if I can.
I could fly food in.
You need food?
The alpha male is dead.
I could fly supplies in.
Goodbye.
Food is still our immediate concern, but we'll manage.
Varren are dangerous, especially an established pack. We've lost so many people already.
I'm sorry, maybe it's just me. I need some time to get myself together.
She's gone. We've lost everything and Greta is gone. I'm sorry. I just don't want to talk right now.
I don't want to talk about that right now. Speak with Fai Dan.
What's to tell? I came here with my wife Greta, looking for adventure, a new life together.
This isn't exactly what we signed up for.
Of course, it would be much better without the geth. We were really starting to enjoy the colony before they came.
The geth are mounting another attack.
If the geth don't kill us, the lack of food just might.
They'll be here any minute.
I don't know if I can handle another attack.
Here, for your trouble. It's not much, I know, but it's all we can spare.
So long, Commander.
Tell me about yourself.
I should go.
Goodbye.
Personal questions
The alpha varren -- he's huge and he's mad. Rabid, maybe. Totally uncontrollable.
Not a problem.
I'll hold this position in case those things try to attack again.
I'm not the best shot, but I'll do what I can.
I'll try to keep an eye on things. I don't know how long we can hold out while their command post is intact.
I want to help, but this is all I can do. I have to stay here, no matter what.
When I could think, I hoped more of us would survive.
You'll have to excuse me. My thoughts are with Davin, not the colony.
I just want to go. The colony was our adventure together, Davin and I.
Thank you for freeing us.
The Thorian forced me to think what it wanted. I felt when you killed it.
That thing got into my head pretty deep. It hurt so much....
I'm glad we'll have another chance here. That's all Davin and I have ever wanted.
Davin and I have had enough. We're getting out while we still have each other.
Oh no. We're heading back to Earth. The sooner Feros is a memory behind us, the better.
Those geth are bloody dangerous.
If I had a credit for every geth I've killed....
Keep alert. They'll be here any minute.
Desperate times call for desperate measures.
You're the commander of the ship that just landed.
Not originally. The captain died in one of the geth raids. I'm the last crew member.
We shouldn't even be here. The salarian merchant promised us a fortune.
There's too much damage. Maybe if the geth stopped attacking I could fix her.
Then again, if there were no geth, I might just stay on a while.
I'm just watching over the ship. Making sure she doesn't get any worse.
Good luck out there.
Hello again. Is there something I can do for you?
Thanks, Commander. It's great to be free again.
It was hell, you know? Any honest thought hurt, just like staring at the sun.
You did a good thing for Feros, but I'm getting out while I can. I've had enough of the colony life.
I'm ready to go back to Earth. Things are simpler there.
Well, you tried, Commander. More than most would have.
I guess the colonists will miss this place. Not me.
Are you the captain of this freighter?
What's wrong with the ship? Isn't she spaceworthy?
What do you do here?
Goodbye.
Ship's owner
Personal questions
I should go.
Can you fly it?
If nothing else, she's good for hiding in when those geth come over the walls.
The geth can't be allowed into the heart of the colony.
They'll... they'll be here any minute.
This is my post. I must defend it at all costs.
I must prepare for the geth attack.
I can't talk right now. I'm busy.
I can't be distracted. Please go.
This work must be completed.
I can't. This is not a good time.
I wish.... I suppose it could be worse.
We just arrived a short time ago. It seemed like any other colony at first, but it's different somehow.
Ah, it's hard to explain. It's kind of like.... I can't describe it. You should speak with Fai Dan. He knows the colony better than me.
No. Well, just ship diagnostics. It's nothing. I should get back to it. Fai Dan wants a report on.... I should go.
No. Thanks, really. Now please, I need to get back to work.
What do you know about the colony?
What do you mean?
It looks like you're monitoring something.
Maybe I can help you. What are you trying to diagnose?
Colony
Different?
What are you doing?
What's the matter?
I won't let you. You must not enter!
You'll have to forgive my wife. Calantha is not in her right mind. She just needs to relax and accept what's happened.
The constant attacks have strained us all. She'll adapt. We all have.
I'm a medic. Or I am since the doctor died. I've tried my best since she was killed.
Just what I was told by Colonial Affairs. It's a little... different from what they claimed.
It's not all bad, though. When the geth are gone, we'll have a chance to create something even more spectacular than before.
I can't think of any reason for an attack like this. We just wanted to build a home.
Please, do what you can to stop the attacks.
Commander. Is there something I can help you with?
I'm free. Thank you for giving me my mind back.
It was awful. Every time I thought about speaking out... even the memory is painful.
We can make this colony work, we just need to build it for ourselves.
After a while, we just instinctively did what the Thorian wanted.
Nothing but bad memories here.
I've had enough of this. There's got to be an easier way to make a living.
What happened to your wife?
What do you do for the colony?
Do you know anything about this planet?
Do you have any idea what the geth were looking for?
I have to go.
Wife's condition
Personal questions
Feros
Goodbye.
Geth
I'm what passes for a medic until we can get all of the survivors together. I hear Juliana's alive. She's much more experienced than I am.
You've been through this yourself. It's always a shame when a colony fails, isn't it?
But I suppose you tried. That's more than most did.
No. She just needs... time. Time to absorb everything. We'll be fine.
I can't tell you much about that. You'd best ask Fai Dan if you really must know.
Fai Dan is our leader. Who better to answer questions about the colony?
Is there anything I can do for her?
Tell me about the colony.
Why can't you tell me? I just want to know about the colony.
Why?
Colony
Can I help?
The geth just keep coming.
My wife needs rest. The attacks are making things worse.
It's just too much to take.
I wish they would just leave us alone.
Commander. I was told to make my supplies available to you, if you wish.
Of course. I may be able to provide a few interesting items.
A well-stocked freighter can be a profitable investment on a new colony.
But once I was here, I decided to stay on. The colony life grows on you after a while.
Yes, good luck.
Is there something I can do for you? I am told to make all my goods available.
I never thought I would be so thrilled to see a soldier.
Forgive my previous inaction, but under the Thorian's influence, every thought was examined and filtered.
Of course. Return in the future and I may even have more to see.
I'll show you what I have, but don't expect me to restock. I'm leaving as soon as the next transport comes in.
I may stay, try to recover my losses. I can have new supplies delivered within weeks.
Perhaps the colony will survive after all.
Feros is a lost cause for a common trader like me. There are better markets on any number of worlds.
I wish you well in your future efforts.
Greetings. What can I do for you?
Let me see what you have.
What's a salarian doing on a human colony?
How do you keep things in stock in conditions like this?
Goodbye.
Let me see what you have in stock.
What will you do now that the fighting is over?
Goodbye.
What do you have for sale?
What are your plans now?
I should go.
What do you have for sale?
Personal questions
Stock
Goodbye.
My full name is Gorot II Heranon Mal Dinest Got Inoste Ledra.
Humans usually employ surname and given name only: Inoste and Ledra in my case.
What's your name, salarian?
Name
My list of consumers has shrunk significantly since the attacks, and few of those have time for "shopping".
We are named for our origins. Gorot II is my homeworld; Heranon, my clan's country. Mal Dinest and Got are the city and district where I live.
Why is your name so long?
Long enough?
I fear the geth will kill us all.
I'm not a fighter. I'm a merchant.
This is not a safe place.
Left unchecked, the geth will soon overwhelm us.
This salarian goes where the credits are. Or I did.
A fascinating place, by all accounts. Though the geth have made it treacherous.
You might like it here too, if you gave it chance, Commander.
I never thought I'd stay in one place for long, but here.... I will stay here.
I can't give you an answer to that, Commander. At least not one that you would comprehend.
Why not try asking Fai Dan? Maybe he can tell you what I can't.
What can you tell me about Zhu's Hope?
This place is barely holding together. Why stay here?
Colony
Why?
I'm sorry, but I can't stop to talk. I have to deal with the water shortage.
The utilities building was one of the first to fall under geth control.
Find the mains and turn them back on. Until then, this colony is dry.
Still no water. A colony needs water to grow.
We are a small group, part of a larger colony. Before the geth attacked.
I wish you luck.
I can think... without pain. Thank you. You've given us a second chance.
Have you given any thought to helping us with our water troubles?
The geth are gone, we've got water again. Everything's good.
Is there anything I can do?
Tell me about the colony.
You are very focused on the water, despite the constant attacks.
I have to go.
The pressure is getting to her. Can't say I blame her.
The water started running not long ago. Thanks to you, I assume.
Now we just need to deal with the geth and we can get back to growing this colony.
You've already helped us, but there's a bigger threat out there.
We have water. I hope we live to enjoy the benefits of it.
Restoring the water supply was a great help, but it means nothing if the geth kill us all.
It's nice to have more mundane worries. Like getting that water flowing again.
The colony can't afford to lose any more of us. We're just too vulnerable.
Really? I'll need to get the relays going, then.
Once the water is flowing again, we can wait for ExoGeni's money to roll in.
I'm free again. Thank you, for everything.
I'd forgot what it was like to have a thought of my own.
It will take time for things to get back to normal around here.
Our water shortage doesn't matter much any more. This colony is dead.
There's not much point in sticking around here.
We could have been a shining beacon for other colonies.
This planet will be deserted soon enough.
You should speak to Fai Dan. It is his responsibility. He knows the colony best.
The colony can't afford to lose any more of us. We're just too vulnerable.
I-- I can't think of anything else. So much has happened, but-- but it hurts.
If I stay focused on this task, the pain goes away.
An understandable reaction, though her discomfort seems almost palpable.
I understand the discomfort she feels. The threat is very real.
Her discomfort seems very real. Constant threat will do that.
Her discomfort seems very real. These people have been through a lot.
You can turn on the water mains yourself.
The water's back on again.
I'll look into it if I have time.
You know where to find the problem with the water.
Unless you plan to make a trip every few days, that wouldn't really solve our problem. We need to be self-sufficient.
That would only help us in the short-term, unless you plan to make a trip every few days. We need to be self-sufficient.
We could wait for ExoGeni ships if we wanted a handout. We need to be self-sufficient.
I could bring in what you need with the Normandy.
I have a ship fueled and ready to go. I could bring water in.
What's wrong?
I could fly water in.
Goodbye.
Colony
Do it yourself.
You think of nothing else?
It's safe now.
I'll keep it in mind.
I could fly water in.
Water's on.
Here. A few credits for your trouble. Thank you again, Commander.
I'd rather not. This is not the time or the place. Please, help us or don't. Otherwise, leave me to my work.
I am not the one to ask about that. Ask Fai Dan, or one of the others.
If we don't die of thirst, the geth will surely kill us all.
They just keep coming.
I can't get the water back on until the geth are removed.
They must be stopped.
I'd appreciate that, Commander.
Tell me about yourself.
What do you know about this planet?
Personal questions
Feros
Thanks for your help, Commander. Here's a small payment for your trouble.
I should go.
Goodbye.
No sense fixing this damn thing, if we're leaving anyway.
I knew they'd turn up eventually! Here. Fai Dan gave me some requisition money. It's all yours.
Now, if I can kick these power cells into place, I'll have this colony up and running in no time.
Your top-of-the-line ship doesn't use the same parts as the old generator we've got. The cells just aren't compatible.
How's a woman supposed to think with guns going off all around?
Finally, that damn thing is out of my head. I can think without pain.
I still need the power cells for this generator, though.
Unless you've got something important, shoo. I'm trying to jury rig something to replace the missing power cells.
Thank you, Commander. I appreciate it.
Nice work with those geth. Glad you showed up.
Would it help if I brought in some power cells from the Normandy? We can certainly spare a few.
I found these power cells in the tunnels. Are they what you're looking for?
If I find anything while I'm looking around, I'll send it your way.
Take a look at these.
I'll see what I can do.
Normandy's power cells
And with the power cells you brought, I can get this place up and running again. Thanks, Commander.
Thanks for getting me these power cells. Now, hopefully, I can get this damn thing working.
Head to the tunnels. Make sure they're secure.
But... what if I find geth there?
Are you saying you won't go?
No! I'll go. I'll... go.
But... I don't know how to use a gun.
Beat them with the end of it if you have to.
Just don't let those geth get by you.
